title: Booking reliability tests
passage: This announcement is for staff using the reliability laboratory. We have added a second vibration test machine, but all tests still require a booking. When submitting a request, include the product weight and the fixture drawing so the laboratory engineer can check whether the setup is safe. Bookings without these details will be returned. Do not bring battery-powered samples into the lab until their safety checklist has been approved. The new machine will be demonstrated on Wednesday at three. Attendance at that demonstration does not replace the separate operator training required before independent use.
passageZh: 這份公告給使用可靠度實驗室的同仁。我們新增了第二台振動測試機，但所有測試仍須預約。提交申請時，請附產品重量與治具圖面，讓實驗室工程師確認配置是否安全。缺少這些資訊的預約會被退回。電池供電樣品的安全檢查表核准之前，不得將其帶進實驗室。新機器將在星期三三點進行示範。參加這場示範不能取代獨立操作前必須完成的操作員訓練。
